configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server Mod Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the mod directory to load, allowing the use of third-party CS:GO mods. Don't change this from the default 'csgo' unless you know what you are doing!

configurationFields.label: Server Steam Group
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of the steam group that the server belongs to. You can find your group's ID on the admin profile page in the steam community

configurationFields.label: LAN Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will operate as a LAN server: no heartbeat, no authentication, and no non-class C addresses

configurationFields.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Steam Game Server Login Token](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers) for the server, to allow it to be listed in the server browser. Use app ID 4465480 when generating the token

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the game mode (game_type and game_mode) to start the server with. Set a Game Mode Flag or Skirmish ID separately to modify the game mode, if required

configurationFields.label: Game Mode Flag
configurationFields.description: Sets a [game mode flag](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Counter-Strike:_Global_Offensive/Game_Modes#Game_Mode_Flags) to modify the selected Initial Game Mode

configurationFields.label: Skirmish ID
configurationFields.description: Sets a [skirmish ID](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Counter-Strike:_Global_Offensive/Game_Modes#Skirmish_Modes) to modify the selected Initial Game Mode

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Server Region
configurationFields.description: Sets the server region shown in the server list

configurationFields.label: Map Group
configurationFields.description: Sets the map group to load to enable map rotation. Alternatively specify a Workshop Collection ID which includes the maps required for rotation

configurationFields.label: Workshop Map ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of a [Steam workshop map](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=730&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems) to download and load on the server. Must be compatible with CS:GO. This will override the Initial Map setting

configurationFields.label: Workshop Collection ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of a [Steam workshop collection](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=730&browsesort=trend&section=collections) to download and load on the server. Must be compatible with CS:GO. This will override the Initial Map setting

configurationFields.label: Steam Web API Key
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Steam Web API key](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey) for the server, to enable the use of a workshop collection

configurationFields.label: Allow Other Map By Players
configurationFields.description: If set, and when the server is hosting a workshop collection, players will be able to play another workshop map on the server when it is empty and then rotate their map cycle into the server collection

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Visible Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum players reported to prospective clients, regardless of the Player Limit. -1 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Pure Server Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether clients are only allowed to use certain files

options.1: All client files except those listed in pure_server_whitelist.txt must match the server

configurationFields.label: Kick Clients On Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will kick clients with mismatching files. Otherwise, it will issue a warning to the clients

configurationFields.label: Require File Consistency
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will enforce file consistency for critical files

configurationFields.label: Force Preload
configurationFields.description: If set, server side preloading will be forced

configurationFields.label: Enable Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheat convars will be allowed to be used on the server

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Server Tickrate
configurationFields.description: Sets the server tickrate

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content from the server (maps, sprays and related)

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for clients to download custom content from, instead of sourcing the content from the server. This allows for faster downloads

configurationFields.label: Allow Upload To Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to upload customisation files to the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Minimum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Maximum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Ping Boost
configurationFields.description: Selects between optimised network code stack. Setting at 2 usually reduces latency toward 1ms without loss of activity input packets

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IPv4 IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the IPv4 IP binding of the server and RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: GSCS requires the server to be bound to a specific IP, rather than 0.0.0.0, for the server to log to GSCS's console. The IP must also be reachable by GSCS

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [command line parameters](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Command_line_options#Command-Line_Parameters_6) (anything that begins with a -) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [console variables](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/List_of_CSGO_Cvars) (anything that begins with a +) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care. Preferably, specify the equivalent under "Additional Server Settings"

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [settings](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/List_of_Counter-Strike:_Global_Offensive_console_commands_and_variables) to include in 'server.cfg' that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire will be enabled (teammates can cause damage to other teammates)

configurationFields.label: Enable Footsteps
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will always play footstep sounds

configurationFields.label: Allow Players To Pause Server
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to pause the server. Not recommended

configurationFields.label: Allow Wait Command
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the wait command will be allowed on clients connected to the server. Recommended to keep disabled to prevent server crash exploits

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Communication
configurationFields.description: If set, voice communication will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Allow Living Talk
configurationFields.description: If enabled, living players can hear all living enemy communications (voice, chat)

configurationFields.label: Allow Dead Talk
configurationFields.description: If enabled, dead players can hear all dead enemy communications (voice, chat)

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: If set, the automatic team balancing feature will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time per map. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation Round Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of rounds to play before the map rotates. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Spectator Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the spectator mode for dead players

options.2: No one; fade to black on death

configurationFields.label: Disable Autokick
configurationFields.description: If set, players will not be auto-kicked

configurationFields.label: Alternate Ticks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server only simulates entities on even numbered ticks

configurationFields.label: Clear Hint History
configurationFields.description: If set, memory of server side hints displayed to a player is cleared

configurationFields.label: Disable SourceTV
configurationFields.description: If set, SourceTV will be disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Demo Recording
configurationFields.description: If set, all games will be recorded as SourceTV demos

configurationFields.label: SourceTV Viewer Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients allowed to connect to the server's SourceTV. 0 = no SourceTV viewers are allowed, the game will only be recorded locally

configurationFields.label: Maximum SourceTV Bandwidth
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum SourceTV spectator bandwidth rate allowed. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Metamod Branch
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Metamod](https://www.metamodsource.net/downloads.php) branch to install

configurationFields.label: Metamod Build Version
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [Metamod build version](https://www.metamodsource.net/downloads.php) to install. Empty = latest build for the branch specified under Metamod Branch

configurationFields.label: SourceMod Branch
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [SourceMod](https://www.sourcemod.net/downloads.php) branch to install

configurationFields.label: SourceMod Build Version
configurationFields.description: Specifies the [SourceMod build version](https://www.sourcemod.net/downloads.php) to install. Empty = latest build for the branch specified under SourceMod Branch

deploymentSteps.name: Metamod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "MetamodBuild=\"{METAMODBUILD}\" && MetamodBranch=\"{MODBRANCH}\" && if [[ -z \"$MetamodBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$MetamodBranch\" && echo \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$MetamodBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"2.0\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1391 ]]; } || { [[ \"$MetamodBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$MetamodBuild\" -ge 1221 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else DownloadURL=\"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; fi; wget -qO metamod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\""

deploymentSteps.name: Metamod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $MetamodBuild='{METAMODBUILD}'; $MetamodBranch='{MODBRANCH}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($MetamodBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://metamodsource.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$MetamodBranch\" -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest Metamod $MetamodBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($MetamodBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid Metamod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($MetamodBranch -eq '2.0' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1391) -or ($MetamodBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$MetamodBuild -ge 1221)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/metamod-source/releases/download/$MetamodBranch.0.$MetamodBuild/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $DownloadURL = \"https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/$MetamodBranch/mmsource-$MetamodBranch.0-git$MetamodBuild-windows.zip\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'metamod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Metamod $MetamodBranch build $MetamodBuild downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "SourceModBuild=\"{SOURCEMODVERSION}\" && SourceModBranch=\"{SOURCEMODBRANCH}\" && if [[ -z \"$SourceModBuild\" ]]; then wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=linux&version=$SourceModBranch\" && echo \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\" && exit 0; elif [[ ! \"$SourceModBuild\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\" && exit 1; fi; if { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.13\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7311 ]]; } || { [[ \"$SourceModBranch\" == \"1.12\" ]] && [[ \"$SourceModBuild\" -ge 7225 ]]; }; then DownloadURL=\"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; else DownloadURL=\"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-linux.tar.gz\"; fi; wget -qO sourcemod.tar.gz \"$DownloadURL\" && echo \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\""

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $SourceModBuild='{SOURCEMODVERSION}'; $SourceModBranch='{SOURCEMODBRANCH}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SourceModBuild)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://sourcemod.net/latest.php?os=windows&version=$SourceModBranch\" -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest SourceMod $SourceModBranch build downloaded\"; exit 0 } } elseif ($SourceModBuild -notmatch '^\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid SourceMod build version format specified\"; exit 1 }; if (($SourceModBranch -eq '1.13' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7311) -or ($SourceModBranch -eq '1.12' -and [int]$SourceModBuild -ge 7225)) { $DownloadURL = \"https://github.com/alliedmodders/sourcemod/releases/download/$SourceModBranch.0.$SourceModBuild/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" } else { $DownloadURL = \"https://sm.alliedmods.net/smdrop/$SourceModBranch/sourcemod-$SourceModBranch.0-git$SourceModBuild-windows.zip\" }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $DownloadURL -OutFile 'sourcemod.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"SourceMod $SourceModBranch build $SourceModBuild downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.name: SourceMod Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'csgo/740'; if (Test-Path 'csgo/cfg/sourcemod') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/cfg/sourcemod' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'csgo/addons/sourcemod/configs') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/configs' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path 'csgo/addons/sourcemod/plugins') { Remove-Item -Path 'sm/addons/sourcemod/plugins' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; Copy-Item -Path 'sm/*' -Destination 'csgo' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'sm' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"
